widgets_values:
=== deus.exe CARD ART TEMPLATE ===

HOW TO USE:
1. Edit the Positive Prompt node with your card's prompt
2. Rename the Save Image filename prefix
3. Change the seed or set to 'randomize'
4. Queue the prompt

For batch generation, use the Python CLI:
  python generate_cards.py --all
  python generate_cards.py --card strike
  python generate_cards.py --card strike --corrupt

See CARD_ART_README.md for full docs.
nodes.title: INSTRUCTIONS

widgets_values:
=== TAG STYLE REFERENCE ===

MELEE: close combat, glowing fists, energy blade, cybernetic arms
RANGED: data projectiles, laser beam, thrown code construct
FIRE: digital fire, burning circuits, thermal overload
ICE: crystallized data, frozen process, blue-white shards
HOLY: golden light, geometric halo, divine radiance, white energy
SHADOW: void energy, dark tendrils, purple corruption, glitch distortion
TECH: circuit board patterns, holographic interface, code terminal
EXPLOIT: broken firewall, injected code, system breach
CURSE: visual glitching, chromatic aberration, data decay

=== TYPE MOODS ===
ATTACK: aggressive, violent, dynamic, red-orange energy
SKILL: protective, technical, precise, blue-cyan energy
POWER: sustained, powerful, emanating, golden aura
CURSE: corrupted, unstable, decaying, purple-black
nodes.title: TAG & TYPE REFERENCE

widgets_values:
=== CORRUPTION VARIANTS ===

To generate corruption variants:
1. Save the base art first
2. Load it with a LoadImage node
3. VAE Encode it
4. Feed into a KSampler with denoise < 1.0

Tier 1 (Tainted):  denoise 0.25
  + subtle purple edge glow, minor glitch artifacts

Tier 2 (Corrupted): denoise 0.45
  + heavy glitch distortion, purple/black color shift

Tier 3 (Demonic):  denoise 0.65
  + full corruption, red-purple energy cracks, reality breaking

Or use the Python CLI: python generate_cards.py --corrupt
nodes.title: CORRUPTION TIERS

widgets_values:
=== LAYER SPLITTING (POST) ===

After generating base art, run KomikoAI
for layer separation:

Foreground: character/main effect
Midground: energy particles/aura
Background: environment/atmosphere

Use the Python postprocess:
  python generate_cards.py --card strike --split-layers

Outputs:
  strike_base_fg.png
  strike_base_mg.png  
  strike_base_bg.png
